decision: Use a sealed prepare-execute-verify provider acceptance campaign with a closed provider catalog, distinct HTTP-command-browser ports, tiered evidence, exact grants, append-only receipts, and independent verification.
hard_stops: secret or credential resolution without exact grant
non-loopback or real browser effect in provider-free packets
auth challenge, rate limit, profile, route or lease mismatch
accounting uncertainty, timeout, redaction or teardown failure
private raw fixture proposed for Git
installed-runtime, schedule, production, release, deployment or issue mutation

invalidation_map.authority_mismatch: selected case and whole-campaign verdict invalid; no transport sample; prior finalized cases preserved
invalidation_map.transport_failure: case transport and yield verdicts invalid; admission, consumed budget, safe failure and prior cases preserved
invalidation_map.parser_or_normalization_failure: normalized and yield claims invalid; transport and accounting observations preserved
invalidation_map.accounting_uncertain: exact budget compliance and overall acceptance invalid; opaque labeled observations preserved
invalidation_map.timeout_or_uncertain_effect: retry eligibility and terminal acceptance invalid; attempts and uncertainty preserved
invalidation_map.redaction_failure: unsafe receipt publication and dependent claims invalid; prior safe receipts preserved
invalidation_map.teardown_failure: lifecycle safety and overall acceptance invalid; completed observations preserved as teardown-incomplete

first_packet.scope: contracts, catalog, replay, effect ledger, redaction, receipts, verifier, CLI, Reddit loopback HTTP, and YouTube fake yt-dlp
first_packet.topology: one coordinator freezes shared contracts, then at most two parallel non-overlapping transport tracers
